easyPrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Neerdiv.
description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Neerdiv.
Neerdiv triggers, causing a player to mill cards equal to its power.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping a basic Island.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Neerdiv.
Repeat.
